cohort: 140 primigravid women at 40 weeks gestation with an amniotic fluid index (AFI) of >=5 cm, a reactive non-stress test (NST) with no evident uterine contraction, Bishop Score of <8, and no notable past medical history
finding: Outpatient cervical ripening with misoprostol appears to be an optimal method, with lower misoprostol doses and oxytocin use in the 50 mug oral group.
